name: Microwave Oven Production Line Solution
summary: Full-line automation solutions for microwave oven manufacturers, covering cavity assembly, door installation, electrical wiring, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The microwave oven production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for microwave oven manufacturers.

Solution Components

The full line covers the entire process including cavity forming, magnetron installation, waveguide installation, door installation, electrical wiring, panel installation, performance testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Automated cavity forming with high dimensional accuracy
  • Precise magnetron installation to ensure microwave performance
  • Automated door installation for consistent sealing
  • Standardized electrical wiring with high connection reliability
  • Fast switching between multiple models for high capacity utilization
  • High level of full-line automation for improved production efficiency

Services

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, to after-sales service.
